verdict.rationale: The xAI REST reference documents GET /v1/models. It lists every model available to the authenticating API key, and its response schema carries IDs, aliases, context_length, pricing and a capabilities object, so an agent can enumerate the live catalog programmatically. The published OpenAPI spec (probe HTTP 200) and the OpenAI-compatible REST API make the endpoint easy for agents to consume. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the endpoint returns the live catalog as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent enumerate the live model catalog programmatically via a documented models endpoint

citations.quote: GET /v1/models — List all models available to the authenticating API key, including model names (ID), creation times, and pricing
